notes.title: 1st update!
notes.notes:
You probably wouldn't even notice this, but we did some minor changes and tweaks.
Thanx for the feedback, by the way! Some of it was included in this fix too.

notes.title: Release date announcement
notes.notes:
Everything is in place now. The game is ready to be out in less than two weeks. 
We can't wait for you to play it, hunt every damn Nazi down and make them pay.
Also please make sure to try the demo in case you haven't already. 
Any feedback is greatly welcome. Every opinion matters. Every suggestion counts.

So please stay tuned for upcoming release and we do hope that you'll like Ashland Dossier as much as we do.

notes.title: Upcoming Release
notes.notes:
The good news is that the game is totally ready to be released on Steam. Basically, it's approved and all, and it's just one click away to appear in store.
But the plan is to release Ashland Dossier on all platforms (consoles in that case) simultaneously.
Now, 2 of 3 certifications are already done, with the last one still pending. As soon as it's settled, the game will be out. 
Our understanding is that it won't take too long. So, we're just around the corner with release.
We're in the final stretch, so it's just a matter of time now.
Hopefully, you'll like the game and all the waiting was surely worth it.

Thank you for your support, and please stay safe.
